units.source_text: 真乃‘年年十月愁霖雨’了。”

en.t: It was truly a case of grieving over the long rains every October.

units.source_text: 众侍女说：“这封信写得格外用心，比以前的饶有风趣，似乎未便置之不理呢。”

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting said, “This letter was written with unusual care, and it has more charm than his earlier ones, so it hardly seems proper to ignore it.”

units.source_text: 槿姬自己也这样想，便答复道：“闻君深宫孤寂，不胜同情。

en.t: Princess Asagao herself thought the same, and so she replied, “I hear that you are lonely in the depths of the palace, and I cannot help feeling sympathy.

units.source_text: 但正如古歌所云：‘恋情倘染色，虽浓亦可观。

en.t: But just as the old poem says: ‘If love were dyed with color, even a deep shade would be worth seeing.

units.source_text: 我今无色相，安得请君看？’因此未能吊慰。

en.t: I now have no color or form, so how could I ask you to look at me?’ Thus she was unable to offer him comfort.
